experiment: Qwen3.8-27B text generation across M3 Pro Mac and physical iPhone 16
prompt: In one short sentence, explain why the sky appears blue.
output: The sky appears blue because shorter wavelengths of sunlight, such as blue, are scattered more effectively by the atmosphere than longer wavelengths.

stage_numerical_validation.finding: Mixed MLX 0.32.2/0.31.1 builds differed beginning at quantized matrix multiplication. Alignment removed those differences in the traced recurrent layers; the first full-attention output still differed at one BF16 value by 0.00390625. The 12-layer prefill comparison remains outside the original per-element tolerance.
stage_numerical_validation.interpretation: Coherent text generation is not proof of numerical equivalence or broad model quality.

matched_mac_only_control.supervisor_cleanup_error: SIGTERM wait timed out; killpg SIGKILL and subsequent SIGTERM returned EPERM. Recorder exited without a final supervisor report.
matched_mac_only_control.followup: A separate process-list check found no remaining record_hybrid_split.py worker. No fatal OOM was observed.
matched_mac_only_control.recovered_from: Persisted events, memory samples, terminal traceback, and process-list follow-up; this is not an original supervisor result.

limitations: One completed short exploratory generation; no sustained or long-context test.
12-layer prefill numerical parity has not passed; tolerances were not loosened.
Both OS memory starting states and file caches were uncontrolled; system swap includes other apps.
The matched Mac-only control triggered the swap guard; its supervisor cleanup failed and the result was recovered from persisted logs. No worker remained at the follow-up process check.
Initial MLX-LM baseline used MLX 0.32.2 and wired memory during generation only; current runs use 0.31.1 and the recommended wired limit during loading too.
No fatal out-of-memory error, validated quality gain, first-ever claim, or production readiness has been established.

prior_attempts.result: Swap guard during loading before early wiring adjustment; zero tokens.
